title: Improving language models by retrieving from trillions of tokens
layout_note: The overview on the left has two rows: the retrieval pathway across the top (retrieval dataset, frozen kNN retriever, transformer encoder, encoded neighbours) and the layer stack along the bottom (input tokens, EMB, RETRO block, READ). The top row drops into the CCA block as K and V, and the input chunks climb back up the left edge into the retriever. A detail panel for CCA fills the right third.
grouping: Two areas side by side: the overview on the left two-thirds and, on the right, a detail panel inside a red dashed frame. In the overview, coloured dashed containers mark groups and carry their name inside the bottom edge in the container's colour: a purple 'Frozen kNN Retriever' around two BERT boxes and an index cylinder, and an orange 'RETRO block (x L)' around ATTN, CCA and FFW. Each block has its own outline colour that its label repeats (yellow EMB and READ, orange ATTN and Transformer Encoder, red CCA, mauve FFW, purple BERT). Chunk identity is a second colour family, green, blue and yellow for chunks 1 to 3, carried by the token cells, the curly braces and the elbow lines that route the chunks to the retriever.
shapes_depth: Flat, no shadows. Blocks are white-filled rounded rectangles with medium-weight coloured outlines; the layer stack is a row of tall upright boxes of equal height, and the Transformer Encoder is an upright box with its label rotated 90 degrees. Block names are bold serif in the outline colour; container labels and symbols (K, V, Q, C1, E1) are sans-serif. The retrieval dataset and the index are cylinders. Tensors are strips of square cells with dark outlines: the input is a vertical column of 12 cells filled by chunk colour, and each pair of retrieved neighbours is a 2 x 5 cell strip in a pale tint of its chunk's colour with the top row darker. Thin black arrows with solid heads run as right-angle elbows and carry text labels (Condition, Attend, K, V, Q). In the detail panel, dotted horizontal lines across the columns line up the chunk boundaries.
proposed_highlight: The new operator, CCA, is the one block with a thick red outline and a red label, and it is the block expanded on the right: the detail panel is framed by a red dashed border with a red bold title 'Chunked cross-attention (CCA)', and its inner CA boxes are red-outlined too, so the panel is tied to its block by colour alone. The retrieval side is set apart in a purple dashed container named Frozen kNN Retriever.
lesson: Each input chunk keeps one fill colour (green, blue, yellow) everywhere it appears, in the input column, in its retrieved neighbours as a paler tint, and in the detail panel, so a reader can follow which chunk attends to which neighbours without reading labels.
notes: elements 'other' = the database cylinders (a large labelled retrieval dataset, a small unlabelled index) and the dotted guide lines in the detail panel. Function-style labels (CA(H1+, E1), CCA(H, E)) and subscripted symbols (C1 to C3, E1, E2, H1 to H3) name tensors instead of tensor sizes. Method name RETRO taken from the drawing ('RETRO block') and the caption. Venue ICML as recorded (venue_source semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2112.04426).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a retrieval row above the model row: Retrieval dataset cylinder -> purple dashed Frozen kNN Retriever -> neighbour cell strips -> Transformer Encoder -> encoded neighbours E1, E2, which drop down as K, V into the CCA block of the layer stack

relations.form: the store (cylinder) and frozen BERT retriever sit top-left beside the main flow; retrieved neighbours are drawn as 2x5 cell strips in pale versions of their chunk's colour
bottom row left to right: token column X -> EMB -> ATTN -> CCA -> FFW -> READ, the middle three inside an orange dashed 'RETRO block (x L)' frame
input tokens are a vertical 12-cell column split by braces into chunks C1 (green), C2 (blue), C3 (yellow)
the encoded neighbours enter CCA from above as K and V while Q arrives from ATTN on the left; a 'Condition' line also runs from ATTN up into the encoder
a red dashed panel on the right redraws CCA: the hidden column H is shifted into chunks H1+, H2+, each paired with its own E_i in a red CA box, dotted lines marking chunk boundaries
chunk colour pairs each token chunk with its neighbours (green C1 -> E1, blue C2 -> E2), repeated in the zoom panel
the 'x L' in the orange dashed frame title marks the repeated block; no unrolling

channels.colour: cell fill = chunk identity (green, blue, yellow) for tokens and their neighbours; block outline colour = module (purple retriever, orange/yellow model blocks, red = CCA, the contribution); colour therefore carries both data identity and module identity
channels.shape: cylinder = dataset store, cell strips/columns = token data, tall rounded rectangles = layers
channels.line: black arrows for model flow; green and blue wires carry each chunk to the retriever; dotted horizontal lines mark chunk boundaries in the zoom
channels.frame: dashed frames = groups: purple = frozen retriever, orange = repeated block, red = zoomed CCA

quality.strengths: retrieved neighbours and tokens are drawn as data with matching chunk colours, so which chunk attends to which neighbours is visible; the zoom panel repeats the CCA red in its frame, title and CA boxes; the novel CCA is the only red block
quality.weaknesses: the green and blue chunk wires to the retriever loop out around the left edge and back across the top, a long detour; EMB, ATTN, FFW and READ are drawn as tall as CCA, so space does not follow novelty; the zoom panel has no connector to the CCA it expands

insights.structure: The left two-thirds stacks a retrieval row (dataset cylinder, purple dashed 'Frozen kNN Retriever' with two BERT boxes, Transformer Encoder, encoded neighbours) over a layer row (EMB, orange dashed 'RETRO block (x L)' holding ATTN-CCA-FFW, READ), and the right third is a red dashed zoom panel of CCA.
insights.data: Input tokens are a vertical 12-cell column coloured green/blue/yellow per chunk with curly braces C1-C3, and each chunk's retrieved neighbours are 2x5 cell strips in a paler tint of that chunk's colour.
insights.emphasis: CCA is the only red-outlined block in the stack and the zoom panel repeats that red in its dashed frame, title and inner CA boxes, tying detail to block by colour.
insights.flow: The input column feeds right through the layer row while thin coloured elbow lines climb the left edge from each chunk into the retriever, and the encoded neighbours drop down into CCA as K and V.
insights.avoid: The long chunk-routing elbows run around the whole figure's left and top edges and cross the 'Condition' line, which is hard to trace; route them shorter if copying.

arrangement.units: one overview made of two rows (retriever on top inside a purple dashed frame, layer stack below with the repeated block in an orange dashed frame) plus a separate red-dashed zoom panel on the right expanding one block
arrangement.inputs_as: a vertical column of chunk-coloured token cells, plus a 'Retrieval dataset' cylinder at top-left
arrangement.shared: the encoded neighbours E1, E2 are drawn in both the overview and the zoom panel
